detail.longDescription:
Trusted by 250,000+ investors worldwide. Stocks to Buy Now Research combines human-led market research, macro analysis and investing education. Explore stock ideas, financial news, earnings calendars, unusual options volume and insider activity. Compare companies, review fundamentals and explore stock price scenarios for short-term trading and long-term investing.

STOCK MARKET HEATMAPS & INDEX RESEARCH

Explore stock market heatmaps and sector performance to see which stocks are leading or lagging. Research major U.S. stocks and their role in indexes such as the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 and Dow Jones Industrial Average. Compare daily, monthly, YTD and longer-term performance, plus premarket and after-hours moves.

TRADING TOOLS & MARKET RESEARCH

• Stock Market Heatmap: visualize stock performance and sector trends.

• Premarket & After-Hours Heatmaps: review moves outside regular trading hours.

• Fear & Greed Index: review market sentiment and its underlying indicators.

• Pentagon Pizza Index: explore alternative activity indicators and available history.

• Hormuz Transit Index: follow vessel crossings, tanker activity and shipping trends.

• Stock Comparison Tool: compare prices, revenue, EPS, net income and company news.

• Industry Peer Comparison: explore P/E ratios, price-to-sales valuations and company fundamentals.

• Stock Technical Analysis: review price charts and technical indicators alongside fundamental research.

• Stock Price Predictions: explore illustrative price scenarios, company outlooks and assumptions across different time horizons.

• Unusual Options Volume: discover unusual call and put activity with market context.

• Options Payoff Calculator: explore strikes, premiums, expiration dates and multi-leg strategies.

• Insider & Fund Activity: follow reported insider buying, insider selling, hedge fund and institutional disclosures.

• Congressional Trading Tracker: explore disclosed stock trades by U.S. politicians, including Nancy Pelosi’s household disclosures. Review reported purchases, sales and transaction dates.

• Hedge Fund & Institutional Holdings Tracker: explore SEC 13F filings, portfolio holdings and quarterly changes for Berkshire Hathaway, associated with Warren Buffett; Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square; and other covered investment managers. Follow reported institutional buying and selling.

• Earnings Calendar: track upcoming earnings and historical company results.

• Economic Calendar: follow CPI inflation, Federal Reserve decisions and market-moving events.

• IPO Calendar: explore upcoming offerings, expected dates and new filings.

• Stock Market News: track company developments, sector updates and macroeconomic research.

• Track Record: review historical stock signal outcomes, options results and benchmark comparisons.

STOCK ALERTS & INVESTING EDUCATION

Follow stock and options setups with supporting analysis. Learn how to start investing, buy stocks, understand options and build a research routine. Explore lessons on diversification, position sizing, risk management and market dynamics.

BUILT BY MARKET PROFESSIONALS

Our platform brings together former Goldman Sachs and Bank of America directors with experience in quantitative analysis, market research and macroeconomics to make investing research easier.
